name: Green Growth
source:
Main character is a normal boy who gets invited by his friend on an adventure to the suburban forest. On his way there he gets separated from his friend and finds his a way to the mysterious fairy world. He becomes friends with many elves and animals there. However, elf village gets attacked by dwarves and monsters. Elves flee from the village, but protagonist can't leave his friends. His little battle begins today.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名普通少年，受朋友邀请前往郊外森林冒险。途中，他与朋友走散，却意外找到通往神秘妖精世界的道路。他在那里与许多精灵和动物成为朋友。然而，精灵村庄遭到矮人与怪物袭击。精灵们逃离村庄，主人公却无法抛下朋友。属于他的小小战斗，就从今天开始。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
